## Overview {.unnumbered}

### EdCamp!

{{< video https://youtu.be/I3ownFNREVQ?si=0l4KzWPfpUKdAdXa >}}


1. 1-4-All to generate topics
2. VOTE!! (poll in Zoom)
3. If your topic is selected as top 4, you are sponsor of that topic/breakout room.
4. [Google Slides for room notes](https://docs.google.com/presentation/d/1SCupUxrGrpnTi8LEPAs8fSrXkC7QyX5qMaiASqn_IlA/edit?usp=sharing)
5. Join the topic/breakout room of your choice.
6. Sponsor of the session shares a brief overview.
7. Discuss, take notes, share, connect...
8. Feel free to wander between rooms.
9. Reconvene to share

[Planning resources](https://digitalpromise.org/wp-content/uploads/2021/01/Edcamp-OrgHandbook_January2021.pdf)
